title: Measuring and Mitigating Biases in Motor Insurance Pricing
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on defining, measuring, and mitigating "fairness biases" and "discrimination" in motor insurance pricing models. It extensively discusses various fairness notions (demographic parity, equalized odds, predictive parity, individual fairness) and their quantification, which are direct applications of ethical principles in AI/ML decision-making. The abstract explicitly mentions "Concerns regarding fairness and ethics have been integral to our societies and philosophies for centuries," indicating that ethical considerations are central to the work.
